projects.title: Personal AI Assistant (Nod + n8n)
projects.problem: Inbox, calendar, memos, newsletters, Drive, bookkeeping, and knowing what today looks like. Small jobs, but together they eat the day.
built: A personal AI assistant built with Nod and n8n: an AI agent plus n8n workflows.
It handles the inbox, calendar, memos, newsletters, Drive and bookkeeping, and puts together a morning briefing.
It runs locally on my own machine.
projects.result: Live and still working, running locally on my machine.

projects.title: ICTR-LD 2026 certificate system
projects.statusNote: Form and personal links are live.
projects.problem: One Google Form link for a whole conference. Someone forwards it to a WhatsApp group, strangers fill it, people submit twice, and somebody ends up copying emails one by one to send certificates.
built: Every participant gets a unique 8-character access code and a personal link with the code already filled in, emailed to them by name.
Each submission is checked the moment it lands: valid, duplicate, or not on the list. Forwarded links get caught.
The certificate step is built: verified responses fill the Slides template, which is exported to PDF, saved to Drive and set up to email.
Built to be safe to rerun. It skips anyone already handled and picks up after the Apps Script time limit. Nothing goes out until a person runs it.
projects.result: Used live for the ICTR-LD 2026 conference. The form and personal links are live, verified responses come back into one sheet, and only people with a valid code get through.

media.alt: A sample ICTR-LD 2026 certificate of participation from the template. The participant's name is blurred.
The Apps Script code that creates the certificate form and personal access codes.

projects.title: RIIC certificate automation in n8n
projects.context: For a RIIC workshop with 400+ participants
projects.problem: A workshop with 400+ participants, and every one of them needs a personalised certificate. Typing names into a template, saving PDFs and emailing them one at a time takes days.
built: Reads the participant list and drops each name into a Google Slides certificate template.
Turns every certificate into a PDF and emails it to the right person through Gmail.
Keeps the files in Google Drive so the office can find any certificate later.
projects.result: Delivered. The full 400+ run went through end to end, and nobody typed a single name.

projects.title: Inbox Agent v1
projects.context: My own build, shared in public. Nov 2026
projects.statusNote: Meeting path tested end to end.
projects.problem: A business inbox mixes meetings, payments, spam and real questions. Important mail gets buried, replies are slow, and nobody can say what came in this week.
built: AI classifies every email into 8 categories: Meeting, Payment, Spam, Inquiry, Support, Personal, Urgent, Other.
Rules do the rest: each email gets labelled and logged, and meetings are booked straight into Google Calendar.
An AI agent drafts human-sounding replies from a FAQ knowledge base.
projects.result: The meeting path ran green end to end: email in, labelled, calendar event booked, logged. The other paths are next in testing.

media.alt: The Inbox Agent workflow in n8n: Gmail trigger, AI email classifier, label nodes per category, calendar booking and the Inbox Boss Agent.

projects.title: RIIC AI Research Agent
projects.statusNote: Built, not yet tested on real office questions
projects.problem: Research staff need quick, academic-quality help: finding sources, summarising papers, grant context. Paid research tools cost money the office doesn't want to spend.
built: An AI research assistant built as an n8n AI Agent with a custom academic system prompt.
It searches the web through Tavily, then answers research questions in a clear academic voice.
projects.result: Built and configured for the RIIC office. Not yet tested on real office questions.
projects.handover: Research help without a paid tool.
